digest.component_or_area: Cloud outbound comment differ and send path
propositions: The differ's body-equality dedup key for Cloud comments is fitted at 32,767 characters (plain text cap), while the send path fits at 32,000 bytes (serialized ADF), causing mismatch for over-length comments
For an over-length comment (>31.8k plain text), the comparison key and landed body diverge, breaking the dedup invariant that both paths must apply identical fit logic

The divergence was introduced in commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt) when the send path moved from the shared truncate_comment_body helper to AdfCodec.fit_outbound, while the differ stayed on the old helper

The ID-based skip (binding_store.is_comment_mapped) cannot fully mitigate this because it guards only against lost map writes; over-length comments with dedup key divergence will re-post on every pass
The fix restores the shared-fitter invariant by making _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment return fit_comment_as_sent (the marker-free text the send path lands) instead of plain truncate_comment_body
